main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean forward 5-bar excess return over coin mean

statistic.name: t of weighted mean (weighted sandwich SE)

main_measure.threshold: confirm if positive with t >= 2; reject if negative with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean forward 5-bar excess return on flat bars with recent high and close below SMA20

decided_by: The forecast-weighted mean excess return is positive with t >= 2.
reading: Active blocks are grid bars 0,5,10,... of each window with forecast > 0; the coin's mean 5-bar return is over all bars of all its windows; excess on supporting bars is the coin's forward return minus that mean; the weighted t uses SE = sqrt(sum w^2 (x-m)^2)/sum w x sqrt(n/(n-1)); 'new high within 20 bars' means a 20-bar closing high 0-19 bars ago; and fewer than 100 blocks gives 'not observable'.
